role: The overworld chunk generator: builds a raw chunk (noise density, per-biome surface, caves, ravines, structure starts, biome array, sky light map) and populates a chunk (structures, lakes, dungeons, biome decoration, world-gen animal spawning, ice and snow).
scope_reason: Every overworld chunk the game generates or populates goes through it; all overworld worldgen is vanilla and in scope (SPEC Decisions, villages on).
